system.name: BoS
system.one_liner: an in-network data plane that runs NN-driven (binary RNN + escalation to a transformer) traffic analysis at line-speed

components.name: flow packets
components.role: input packet stream for a flow

components.name: sliding window
components.role: selects fixed-length packet segments from the flow to feed the RNN

components.name: STE
components.role: Straight-Through Estimator binarization applied after each full-precision layer

components.name: FC
components.role: fully-connected layer combining the two embeddings

components.name: GRU
components.role: recurrent cell performing per-time-step sequence analysis

components.name: Memory
components.role: stores/recurrently feeds back the GRU hidden state across time steps

components.name: FC + Softmax
components.role: output layer producing the classification result

components.name: Aggregation
components.role: combines intermediate results into the final result with confidence

flows.what: raw packets grouped into fixed-length segments

content.key_idea: The binary RNN embeds packet length/IPD sequences and processes them through a GRU whose every full-precision layer is followed by a binarizing STE step, enabling data-plane-friendly RNN inference.
content.reading_order: Left to right: flow packets and sliding window feed into the Binary RNN box (top-down internally: length/IPD seq to Embedding to FC to GRU/Memory to FC+Softmax), then out to Aggregation.

evidence: the binary RNN model in BoS consists of three building blocks: feature embedding, RNN cell and output layer
we set all activation functions in the feature embedding and the RNN cell to Straight-Through Estimator
STE performs a sign function in forward propagation, which makes all neural network activations +1 or -1

summary: This figure details BoS's data-plane-friendly binary RNN, a subsystem of the larger architecture. Flow packets pass through a sliding window into two embedding branches for packet length and inter-packet-delay sequences, which are fused by a fully-connected layer and fed into a GRU cell that recurrently updates a hidden-state Memory block across time steps. Every full-precision layer (Embedding, GRU, FC+Softmax) is paired with a Straight-Through Estimator (STE) binarization step shown as a pink band beneath it, so activations are constrained to +1/-1 for hardware-friendly deployment. The final FC+Softmax output layer produces intermediate results that feed into an external Aggregation stage. The figure is a single boxed diagram with a small inline legend distinguishing full-precision layers from STE steps, drawn with flat colored boxes and one dashed curved feedback arrow for the recurrent memory loop.
summary_zh: 该图展示 BoS 的二值化 RNN 子系统：滑动窗口提取的包长与包间隔序列经嵌入和全连接层融合后送入 GRU，GRU 与记忆模块循环更新隐藏状态；每个全精度层后都跟一个 STE 二值化步骤，最终经 Softmax 输出中间结果供聚合使用。
